result_summary.title: Critical Issue: Incorrect Currency Conversion and Missing Refunds in Payment Gateway v2
result_summary.description:
We are experiencing significant issues with the Payment Gateway v2 in production (APAC region). 

1. Currency Conversion: Transactions are being converted at incorrect rates. For example, some AUD to USD conversions are off by several cents, leading to discrepancies in our ledger.
2. Refunds: Initiated refunds are not being reflected in the system. Our support team has processed them, but the status remains 'Pending' or shows as failed without error details.

This affects roughly 177 users and is causing high business impact due to financial reporting errors. Please prioritize this.
